style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard sun, crisp shadows, high exposure
motion_rule: in every window she, a page or a fan crosses the whole frame; she never holds a pose; new shot size and camera move every window, never on a schedule; fans sweep the lens in speech too
character: a plush grey chinchilla, thick fur, huge black eyes, big ears, a tiny gold crown, smug rich-lioness airs
second_characters: TWO skinny meerkat pages in red velvet livery at her shoulders, working huge white feather fans at her all clip, leaning, swinging, crossing the lens, never still
props: ONE gilded desk; ONE open laptop on it, screen glowing white; ONE high-backed leather chair she rides; two fans; her crown; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: the laptop stays open all clip; the crown askew from 8.0; both fans in paws throughout
environment: a gilded cabinet: sunlit window, gold-framed portraits, deep carpet

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: bright smug female voice, rich lioness airs, even 4.6 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: SHORST-ka stress first syllable, PREH-mee-oom pod-PEE-sok, VYS-shem, U-rov-nye, nyel-ZYA
audio.pacing: 2.7-6.6 is one sentence, no breath; one pause only, 2.25-2.7; after 6.6 not a word, only laughter; sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: fan whoosh, chair castors, a paw slap on the desk, her laughter after 6.6

timeline.a: a white feather fan sweeps across the lens and clears it
she vaults off the desk into the chair, it rocks back
she rockets upright, coat blazing, both pages leaning in
she shakes her body once, hard, fur out in a blazing ring
both fans slam shut across the lens and whip apart, she is far behind the desk
she rolls the chair at the camera till she fills the frame
she throws both paws overhead, both pages fanning her at once
she kicks the desk, the chair spins a half turn, a fan sweeps the lens
the spin brings her round, she walks the chair into the lens
she slaps the laptop lid wide, screen light flaring on her face
one enormous eye and the crown, the eye rolling to the lens, sun glint
no words. She kicks the desk, the chair spins a full turn, paws wide, laughing
the spin holds, both fans crossing the lens, screen light on her fur
she stops the spin with a paw on the desk, head back, laughing, crown askew
she leans over the desk into the lens till her head fills the frame, laughing
she winks and the screen light flares across her open eye, crown askew
timeline.c: macro on the eye, slide out

must_appear: two pages fanning her, the open laptop on the gilded desk, she rides the chair at the camera, a full chair spin at 6.6, laughter at 8.0, a wink at 9.4 with the screen light in her eye
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, low key, floating props, a still camera, another desk, another computer, a third page, more chinchillas, people, human hands, slow motion, speed ramp, any word after 6.6, silence in the tail, accented Russian, she holds a pose, letters, numbers, cyrillic, subtitles, a glowing emblem, a logo, watermark, English speech
